name: Glimmer
tagline: A real photo editor for the Mac, with AI where it helps.
summary: Glimmer is a native macOS photo editor with layers, masks, adjustment layers, filters, retouching, text and paths. Auto Enhance, sky and people selection, perspective correction and more run on your Mac for free; generative edits use your own key with OpenRouter or another service you choose. AI agents can drive it too, through a local API.

features.title: Layers, the way you expect
features.text: Pixel, adjustment, fill, text and shape layers, groups, masks, clipping masks, smart objects, 24 blend modes (plus pass-through for groups) and layer styles, all non-destructive in 16-bit linear colour.

features.title: One-click fixes on your Mac
features.text: Auto Enhance and Auto Color add editable adjustment layers. Auto Straighten levels the horizon and Suggest Crop frames the subject, faces included. Free and private.

features.title: Select the sky, people or anything
features.text: Select Sky, Select People and Select Subject run on the Mac. Magic Select outlines any object from a few clicks.

features.title: Suggestions for the photo you have open
features.text: The omnibar looks at your image and offers what it needs, such as "Straighten 4.0°" or "Image Text to Layers". Type a command or describe an edit.

features.title: Generative editing with your own key
features.text: Generate, Generative Fill, Remove Object, Expand, Relight, Harmonize and more through OpenRouter or another service you choose. You pay the service for what you use; there is no Glimmer account.

features.title: Text that stays text
features.text: Give single words their own font, size or colour, warp the text or run it along a path. Scale, rotate and skew it with Free Transform, and you can still change the words.

features.title: Text in photos becomes editable
features.text: Image Text to Layers turns the words in a photo into text layers at the right size and colour. Straighten Document flattens a page or a sign shot at an angle.

features.title: Batch editing and photo rating
features.text: Run Auto Enhance, a preset or a saved action on whole folders. Rate Photos flags blurry shots and screenshots so you keep the best.

features.title: Export for the web in one step
features.text: Set a longest side and a size limit in kilobytes, and Glimmer finds the best quality that fits. PNG, JPEG, HEIC, TIFF and WebP.

features.title: Works with Flimmer and Jämmer
features.text: Draw an episode's waveform from Jämmer as a cover, edit a frame for Flimmer and save it straight back, or let Flimmer ask for cover art in podcast sizes. All on your Mac.

features.title: Agents and Shortcuts can drive it
features.text: Hand your AI agent one line from Help › Agent Access. It reads the guide on your Mac and edits through a local API: open, combine images, crop, resize, transform, style text, undo and export. Six Shortcuts actions do the same for files, without opening a window.

features.title: Brushes and retouching
features.text: Pressure-sensitive brushes with presets, clone and healing, dodge and burn, blur, sharpen, smudge and Liquify, all respecting your selection.
